distributionPreference: Favor materially different approaches to authored objectives, changing tactics, varied SRD combatant compositions, and a mix of delegated and exact character choices. Keep the encounter compact enough to play through the public SDK. Use only Small or Medium combatants and exactly one combatant per canonical stat-block identity; never repeat an identical stat block in the same scenario. Prefer distinct melee-only combatants on open bright-light terrain; do not require corpse-square traversal, corpse-square end-position restrictions, weapon-ready switching, duplicate-identical initiative groups, unsupported object adjudication, or other undocumented table state. Every ammunition-using combatant must have an explicit starting ammunition stock stated in the scenario prose; otherwise prefer combatants without ammunition requirements.
